_comment: Cask Sounding tiers — see docs/minigame-cask-sounding.md §4. Only ROW counts are given free; column counts were measured to make boards self-solving (median par 2 on a 5x5) and are deliberately absent. 'gaps' are empty rack slots that break the 8-neighbourhood, which stops the top tier degenerating into pattern-matching. 'hiddenRows' is the Vault's real difficulty lever: rows whose count the ledger never gives. Density and gaps alone were measured to leave the Vault no harder than the Cellar (median par 9 for both); taking a free clue away is the dial that actually moves it — measured on the Vault geometry, hiding 0/1/2/3/4 rows gives median par 9/9/10/11/12. Grid size is capped at 6x6 because the par solver's cost grows about an order of magnitude per step up (§3).
